craft_notes: Sthāyin: self-offering — even leavings tasted. Rows: seat, gift, tasting. Rejected: skipping leavings — killed: tasting is the rite. Read aloud: humble close.

lines: There draw the lucky cross, there set the golden seat, there adore the whole faring-way;
by that enthrone that seat; to him worship, sating, dinner, fee, self — thus given;
beg the leavings, bow, taste yourself — then wheel-worship do.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra svāstikaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra sauvarṇaṃ pīṭhaṃ dattvā tatra samastam adhvānaṃ pūjayitvā tatpīṭhaṃ tena adhiṣṭhāpya tasmai pūjāṃ kṛtvā tarpaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ dakṣiṇām ātmānam iti nivedya naivedyocchiṣṭaṃ prārthya vanditvā svayaṃ prāśya cakrapūjāṃ kuryāt
